description: Read a Drawbridge/draw.io network diagram and return its contents as structured JSON: devices, links, pages, layers and groups — for auditing or querying an existing drawing. Results carry `name`: a suggested basename for this diagram. Write every file for one diagram into its own directory named after it — <name>/<name>.drawio, <name>/<name>.svg, <name>/<name>.cables.csv — so two diagrams never share a directory.
name: describe
